race.comment: LIGHT FILLED (5) is the one to beat after breaking through in decisive style at Dunkeld, winning a Mdn by three and a half lengths with Alyssa Webb aboard. That followed a solid Donald placing on heavy ground, and her record around this trip gives the win enough depth to translate to this. MAGIC FIELD (7) is the main danger, with his latest fifth at Murray Bridge only beaten just over two lengths and his previous third at this track backed by an excellent track-and-distance profile. ELNAJEEB (3) brings Queensland form, having been beaten just over three lengths as a well-supported favourite at Ipswich after a sound Class 1 fourth at Eagle Farm; the query is coming back to 900m. POSITIVE IMAGE (2) has two plain recent runs to overcome, but the class context eases and a close Hamilton trial keeps him in the mix for a sharper second-up showing.
